coords: three.js: y up, building front faces +z
note: instances: [x, y, z, yawRad, scale, tint]; yaw is rotation.y; tint in 0..1 for per-instance colour variation; LOD i is drawn from lodDistancesM[i-1] on (LOD0 below lodDistancesM[0]); maxDistanceM (optional): not drawn beyond it; castsShadowWithinM: suggested shadow-casting range; wind (optional, 0..1, missing = 1): multiplier on the foliage wind
